notes:
SenderWire 0.11.0: a new look and a more native app.
New logo and app icon, a calmer redesign with a serif wordmark, and Settings now lives in your Profile. Share text, photos, videos and files into SenderWire from any app, straight into a chat or a new journal entry. Notifications show who wrote, stack each chat into one conversation, and let you reply or mark as read; likes and follows are grouped. Clips play again. Reactions in encrypted chats are now encrypted too, and the app warns you when a contact's security code changes.
